title: Group spaces in the Stata building by the access level and usage type. For
question: Group spaces in the Stata building by the access level and usage type. For each group, state the access level, usage type, name of the space, the number of spaces, total area across all rooms in the space, and average area across all rooms in the space. Display the access level only if it differs from the previous entry. Include subtotals for each access level, usage type, and space name, subtotals for each access level, and a grand total across all access levels. Exclude usage type that includes "STORAGE". All numerical values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS access_level,
    u.SPACE_USAGE AS usage_type,
    d.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS space_name,
    d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS area
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL d
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = d.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_USAGE u ON u.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = d.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'
    AND (u.SPACE_USAGE IS NULL OR u.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%')
),
space_agg AS (
  SELECT access_level, usage_type, space_name,
         COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
         SUM(area) AS total_area,
         AVG(area) AS avg_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type, space_name
),
space_rows AS (
  SELECT access_level, usage_type, space_name, num_spaces, total_area, avg_area,
         1 AS lvl,
         1 AS sort_access,
         2 AS sort_usage,
         3 AS sort_space
  FROM space_agg
),
usage_sub AS (
  SELECT access_level, usage_type,
         NULL AS space_name,
         SUM(num_spaces) AS num_spaces,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         SUM(total_area)/SUM(num_spaces) AS avg_area,
         2 AS lvl,
         1 AS sort_access,
         2 AS sort_usage,
         1 AS sort_space
  FROM space_agg
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type
),
access_sub AS (
  SELECT access_level,
         NULL AS usage_type,
         NULL AS space_name,
         SUM(num_spaces) AS num_spaces,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         SUM(total_area)/SUM(num_spaces) AS avg_area,
         3 AS lvl,
         1 AS sort_access,
         1 AS sort_usage,

  GROUP BY access_level

grand AS (
  SELECT NULL AS access_level,
         NULL AS usage_type,

  SELECT
    b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS access_level,
    u.SPACE_USAGE AS usage_type,
    d.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS space_name,
    d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS area
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL d
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = d.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_USAGE u ON u.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = d.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'
    AND (u.SPACE_USAGE IS NULL OR u.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%')
),
space_agg AS (
  SELECT access_level, usage_type, space_name,
         COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
         SUM(area) AS total_area,
         AVG(area) AS avg_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type, space_name
),
space_rows AS (
  SELECT access_level, usage_type, space_name, num_spaces, total_area, avg_area,
         1 AS lvl,
         1 AS sort_access,
         2 AS sort_usage,
         3 AS sort_space
  FROM space_agg
),
usage_sub AS (
  SELECT access_level, usage_type,
         NULL AS space_name,
         SUM(num_spaces) AS num_spaces,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         SUM(total_area)/SUM(num_spaces) AS avg_area,
         2 AS lvl,
         1 AS sort_access,
         2 AS sort_usage,
         1 AS sort_space
  FROM space_agg
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type
),
access_sub AS (
  SELECT access_level,
         NULL AS usage_type,
         NULL AS space_name,
         SUM(num_spaces) AS num_spaces,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,

         3 AS lvl,
         1 AS sort_access,
         1 AS sort_usage,
         1 AS sort_space

  GROUP BY access_level
),
grand AS (
  SELECT NULL AS access_level,
         NULL AS usage_type,
         NULL AS space_name,
         SUM(num_spaces) AS num_spaces,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         SUM(total_area)/SUM(num_spaces) AS avg_area,

MIN(i.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(i.AREA) AS area_variance, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE AS join_access_level_code FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS f ON i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG GROUP BY f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) SELECT alv.access_level_code, alv.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, alv.campus_sector, alv.num_of_rooms_variance, fas.FLOOR, fas.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fas.area_range, fas.area_variance FROM access_level_variance AS alv JOIN floor_area_stats AS fas ON alv.join_access_level_code = fas.join_access_level_code ORDER BY alv.access_level_code, alv.campus_sector, fas.FLOOR

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance, term_sort FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort) = BUILDING_NAME_LONG THEN NULL ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_name_long, ORGANIZATION_NAME, room_count, avg_area, SPACE_UNIT, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev, DEPT_CODE FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ROOM_FULL_NAME) AS room_count, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(SPACE_UNIT) AS SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, MAX(DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS rw JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort
